## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Grindavik, Iceland. It starts at Norðurljósavegur 9 240 Grindavík.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Feeling 'blue?' We know how to melt your cares away! Iceland's famous Blue Lagoon is a must-see destination in the Land of Fire and Ice, and if you book the coveted 'Comfort Package' ticket, you'll be floating on cloud nine in no time.
>
> This pass is your gateway to the lagoon's legendary waters, complete with a cosy towel and rejuvenating silica mud mask. You'll also get a complimentary drink from the in-water bar - beer, wine, or even a smoothie.
>
> Relax and unwind in an unparalleled wellness experience that spans 8,700 square meters of steaming geothermal bliss! From the soothing sauna and steam room to the invigorating massage waterfall, to the mineral-rich waters, it's a wonderland you'll be talking about for months.
>
> Want to know more? Check out our [Insider’s Guide to Visiting the Blue Lagoon now](https://www.tiqets.com/blog/an-insiders-guide-to-visiting-the-blue-lagoon/)

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €156.41. It was rated 4.4 out of 5 from 78 ratings and 41 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
